s3-000-93f81e6f2680b9ba.wav.text: Before any code, here is the idea in one sentence.

s3-001-4f4b942505020a7e.wav.text: Attention is a dictionary lookup that has been made differentiable.

s3-002-530a702864860a47.wav.text: Think about what an ordinary lookup does.

s3-004-615cb31280237ec2.wav.text: It gets compared against every key in the table.

s3-005-adc4432f5c2d7908.wav.text: The one that matches wins, and you get back its value.

s3-006-03e540eb358aa73b.wav.text: Attention does exactly that with two changes.

s3-007-958e8b8b54db3882.wav.text: First, the comparison is a dot product rather than an equality test, so instead of matching or not matching you get a score, a number saying how well those two things line up.

s3-008-eebb37e2295c4f06.wav.text: Second, instead of taking the winner you take a weighted average of every single value, with the weights coming from a softmax over the scores.

s3-010-6e99fa78f9a13efa.wav.text: A hard lookup, an argmax, has no useful derivative.

s3-011-19cbcea87a023738.wav.text: Nudge the query slightly and either nothing changes at all, or the answer jumps to a completely different entry.

s3-012-67797ca377d8dabb.wav.text: There is nothing for gradient descent to hold on to.

s3-013-115977c08074db7c.wav.text: Soften it into a weighted average and suddenly every weight moves smoothly with every input.

s3-015-4750641614a6cd41.wav.text: That is the reason this architecture exists.

s4-000-d724ff1c8e82c0f9.wav.text: So where do the queries and keys and values come from.

s4-001-00f6220ed09df2af.wav.text: Every token emits three vectors, and each has a job you can say in English.

s4-002-85120ccce2ee8ac0.wav.text: The query is what this token is looking for.

s4-003-e2b75706ec98b123.wav.text: The key is what this token is, considered as a lookup target.

s4-004-19c7e7caba66453a.wav.text: The value is what this token contributes if it gets chosen.

s4-006-b0270a752960add0.wav.text: Q equals X times W q, K equals X times W k, V equals X times W v.

s4-008-11676ebe77fd3abb.wav.text: And now the code, which is one line.

s4-011-3375962f42440216.wav.text: Those three matrices are the only parameters in the entire attention mechanism.

s4-012-962faf874cdd7d87.wav.text: Everything else you are about to see is arithmetic with no weights in it at all.

s5-000-22f1dbf31ab736ca.wav.text: Now watch one query do its job.

s5-001-337e2a255f12cd72.wav.text: Token five is asking a question.

s5-002-2d62383fef4b8e5c.wav.text: Its query vector gets compared against the key of every token it is allowed to see, which is tokens zero through five.

s5-003-19de544876170c2c.wav.text: Five dot products, five scores, and then a softmax turns those scores into weights.

s5-004-0a21b351168b44db.wav.text: Look at the numbers on the keys.

s5-010-b8ffafc8d0478e69.wav.text: Add those up and you get one, exactly, because that is what a softmax is for.

s5-011-771e357a5990d876.wav.text: So this query has decided that token one is what it was looking for, with a bit of interest in token four, and essentially no interest in the rest.

s5-012-0d576fb0a131f47e.wav.text: The output is the values of those five tokens, averaged with those five weights.

s5-013-f27d9bffab4c85a3.wav.text: Sixty one percent of token one's value, twenty three percent of token four's, and the remainder split between three tokens it has mostly ignored.

s5-014-8eeaafbc1c24f1bc.wav.text: That is one head of attention producing one output vector.

s6-000-cd22cbd903b979c7.wav.text: Here is the whole thing written down.

s6-002-05528b4dae7e0692.wav.text: Score every query against every key.

s6-003-4efed01498001adc.wav.text: Divide by the square root of the head width.

s6-006-656354ab0b45603e.wav.text: Use the result to average the values.

s6-007-940afd4d8352002e.wav.text: Now the equation, and this is the one line people put on slides.

s6-008-ceaa3fc99def9a90.wav.text: Attention of Q, K and V equals softmax of Q K transpose over root d k, times V.

s6-009-0c0657384af4424f.wav.text: And now the code, which is four lines, and which you should read as the definition rather than as an implementation of the equation.

s6-015-00d9e1ea49e3aa49.wav.text: This is the load-bearing part of it, and it fits on a business card.

s7-000-bd85a1ea09b70c26.wav.text: Now the divide by root d k, because it is the one part of that formula that looks arbitrary and is not.

s7-001-c2fa4d9fb2d62a16.wav.text: Queries and keys have roughly unit variance in each coordinate.

s7-002-4c3c513c84296bd2.wav.text: Their dot product sums over d k coordinates, so its variance grows with d k.

s7-004-f4db04bb81880e6d.wav.text: And here is what bigger scores do to a softmax.

s7-005-4b70383aa9679791.wav.text: This chart is a real measurement: two hundred random rows of sixty four keys each, and the bar height is the largest weight the softmax produced.

s7-006-6f805b36a24f3815.wav.text: At width four it is zero point two seven.

s7-007-d6f8d0b43edd26fe.wav.text: At sixty four, zero point eight one.

s7-008-c06ee0289c952a59.wav.text: At one thousand and twenty four, zero point nine six.

s7-009-9ab85122a6bc4888.wav.text: The softmax has collapsed onto a single key.

s7-010-4ac99e96d35417ff.wav.text: And a saturated softmax has almost no gradient, so that layer has stopped learning, and it stops learning more the wider you build it, which is the exact opposite of what you want from a scaling knob.

s7-012-4d53931ef1a3b2ce.wav.text: Same width, one thousand and twenty four, with the division by root d k.

s7-015-92e8ebb90476df01.wav.text: The scaling is a variance correction.

s7-016-ac4451fb8c39f8e8.wav.text: It is not a normalisation ritual and it is not there for numerical stability.

s9-000-3795eff940f02317.wav.text: One gotcha before we stop, and it is the one that costs people days.

s9-001-3df81bff90aa4799.wav.text: The causal mask is not a performance detail.

s9-002-10155f2282da8edf.wav.text: It is the entire reason a decoder can generate.

s9-003-d10a426f19387fcd.wav.text: Take it away and every token can see the tokens after it, which includes the one it is being asked to predict.

s9-004-4dd30e6cd5f7c547.wav.text: Loss falls off a cliff, and it looks like you have done something right.

s9-005-6e8597cebaa066aa.wav.text: Then you sample from the model and it produces nothing coherent, because at generation time there is no future to look at.

s9-006-b25c5bcb7a977952.wav.text: In our own run, without the mask, token zero placed six percent of its attention on token three, a token that will not exist for another three steps.

s9-007-62d375531f62b251.wav.text: With the mask, that weight is exactly zero.
